scope.artifact_records: Separate historical study/checkpoint evidence, linked and hashed for context; not relabeled as fresh checks.
scope.examples: Six download-free examples and four already-prepared mechanistic studies.
scope.exclusions: Markdown, generated example results/figures, this validation output, other v0.2 validation outputs, target/, root models/, .git/, Python bytecode. This is not a hermetic dependency/toolchain attestation.
scope.fresh_build_meaning: Direct binaries are hashed after a successful cargo build --examples; Cargo may reuse its validated build cache.
scope.inventory: Source, Cargo metadata, fixtures and structured protocols; historical measurement records are included separately because Python tests consume them as fixtures.
scope.purpose: One fixed local v0.2 source/interface validation and prepared CPU example replay.
scope.qualification: No coverage measurement, accelerator runtime validation, package qualification, training validation, or release/support promotion is performed or claimed.
